package.name: motkin_five_bar_force_velocity_py
package.description: Python endpoint force-to-velocity controller (qdot = J^T f_c) for the motkin_dual_motor_testbed five-bar mechanism. Drives the joints through the motkin_forward_command_controller ~/commands topic, using an analytical (closed-form) Jacobian derived from the URDF geometry -- no Pinocchio or other rigid-body library involved.
package.author: Olivier Stasse
